title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics/perfect_gas.cpp and numerics/viscous_flux.cpp implement 2-D compressible ideal-gas and Newtonian/Fourier terms; report supplies formulas.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh/cgns_reader.cpp:94–106,141–147,230–233 reads multi-zone first-base TRI/QUAD/BAR sections, explicitly rejecting polymorphic MIXED; geometry and adjacency are built in distributed mesh.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics/residual.cpp:115–116,224–237 evaluates face flux and scatters opposite contributions; ghost gradients/limiters are exchanged.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics/riemann_flux.cpp implements Roe with entropy fix and HLLC/Rusanov alternatives. Report discloses a latent HLLC issue for separate review.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: physics/boundary_conditions.cpp implements farfield/slip/no-slip; post/surface_output.cpp:54–76 writes imposed no-slip velocity rather than cell-center velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: numerics/gradients.cpp uses prebuilt weighted least-squares stencils; residual.cpp:57–61,81–89 exchanges ghost gradients and limiter factors.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: numerics/limiter.cpp implements Venkat and positivity fallback; report discloses limiter switching/plateau effects.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: post/forces.cpp:68–100 uses corrected wall-normal velocity gradient and wallShearTraction to exclude normal viscous traction; Newtonian/Fourier residual is implemented.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solve/steady_driver.cpp:523–538 tests residual plateau with forces_stationary; :615–660 restores and records best state when final residual regresses.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: transient_driver.cpp:90–133 tests full spatial+BDF residual. Selected 30000-row inner history gives min49/max144/mean132.818 and metadata reports zero misses; exact per-step initial ratios are not independently reconstructed.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: distributed_mesh.cpp:57–78 constructs global mesh only in root-scoped setup; METIS and neighbor halos are present. tab_scaling.tex compares np1/2/4/8 NACA/cylinder at step1500.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
